title: Core Flashcard System
description: Four reference-dependent images establish a cheerful flashcard system and extend it across alphabet, number, animal, and object-recognition studies.
creative_direction: Image 01 defines the rounded card frame, pastel studio styling, illustration density, and empty caption zones. Images 02-04 must preserve the same card proportions, spacing, palette anchors, and tactile production cues while swapping the teaching subject.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-alphabet-board first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-number-counting-board, 03-animal-recognition-board, 04-daily-object-board. Queue may run those images concurrently after 01-reference-alphabet-board is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
